name: smwmusic-spyro-eternal-night-temple-of-lightning
title: Spyro: Eternal Night - Temple of Lightning
description:
An orchestral style piece from the GBA version of The Legend of Spyro: Eternal Night. It is a dramatic, uptempo castle theme featuring organs, strings, horns, celesta*, snare, timpani and cymbals. Perfect for fast castle levels. Originally composed by Tom Miller.


*technically an electric piano
